title: The Ocean Memorial
author: Barış Kısır
premise: Marine salvage engineer Noor Haddad is hired to raise a luxury yacht from the floor of the Mid-Atlantic ridge — forbidden by three governments. The yacht sank with a data core that never surfaced, and Noor's own brother is on the crew list of the dead.
long_description: 2089. Noor takes the forbidden salvage of the Lucida to find her brother Karim's body and the data core that exposes a conspiracy. Sabotage, a booby-trapped wreck, and two rival factions contest the core; Noor broadcasts the evidence and gives Karim a sea burial — the Ocean Memorial.
main_characters: Noor Haddad — salvage engineer, brilliant, grieving
Karim — her brother, dead, present in memory
Ole — Norwegian dive master, loyal, funny
